create_FrescoV2VPipeline: create a video-to-video Stable Diffusion pipeline with FRESCO algorithm for temporal consistency
run_FrescoV2VPipeline_call: run the FrescoV2VPipeline __call__ method to generate video frames from input frames and control frames
apply_FRESCO_opt: apply FRESCO-based UNet feature optimization to improve spatial and temporal consistency in generated video
apply_FRESCO_attn: apply FRESCO-guided attention processors to the UNet for spatial, temporal, and cross-frame attention
get_flow_and_interframe_paras: get optical flow and occlusion parameters from GMFlow model for temporal-guided attention and optimization
